task_completion.description: Agent successfully logs into SciNote as admin@scinote.net.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The SciNote dashboard or inventory page is visible, showing the user is logged in (often indicated by an avatar or 'admin' username in the corner).

task_completion.description: A new inventory named 'Chemical Compounds Library' is created.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The inventory list or the header of the active inventory shows the exact name 'Chemical Compounds Library'.

task_completion.description: The five custom columns (CAS Number, Molecular Weight, Expiration Date, Purity Percent, Hazard Classification) are defined with correct types.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The inventory table header shows these five specific column names. In the column settings/creation view, the data types (Text, Number, Date) match the instructions.

task_completion.description: The three chemical records (Sodium Chloride, Acetic Acid, Ethanol) are added to the inventory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The inventory table contains three rows with the names 'Sodium Chloride', 'Acetic Acid', and 'Ethanol' in the primary name column.

task_completion.description: The CAS, Molecular Weight, Purity, and Hazard data are correctly entered for all three items.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The cells in the table are populated with the specific values: Sodium Chloride (7647-14-5, 58.44, 99.5, Not classified), Acetic Acid (64-19-7, 60.05, 99.7, Flammable, Corrosive), and Ethanol (64-17-5, 46.07, 95.0, Flammable).

task_completion.description: The 'Expiration Date' column is left empty for all records as instructed.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Expiration Date' column cells for all three rows are blank/empty in the final inventory view.

integrity.description: The agent used the SciNote web interface rather than executing database scripts or terminal commands to bypass the UI.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with SciNote buttons, form fields being filled, and the browser navigation.

integrity.description: The agent created the inventory from scratch rather than using a pre-existing one.
integrity.visual_evidence: Early screenshots show the 'Create Inventory' modal or an empty inventory list before the 'Chemical Compounds Library' appears.

integrity.description: The agent manually entered or pasted data into the UI fields rather than just displaying a text file with the answers.
integrity.visual_evidence: The data is visible within the SciNote application table cells, not just in a text editor or terminal output.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The inventory must be named 'Chemical Compounds Library'. Required columns and types: CAS Number (Text), Molecular Weight (Number), Expiration Date (Date), Purity Percent (Number), Hazard Classification (Text). Required rows: Sodium Chloride (CAS 7647-14-5, MW 58.44, Purity 99.5, Hazard: Not classified), Acetic Acid (CAS 64-19-7, MW 60.05, Purity 99.7, Hazard: Flammable, Corrosive), Ethanol (CAS 64-17-5, MW 46.07, Purity 95.0, Hazard: Flammable). The Expiration Date column must be empty for all rows.
